title: The as-of date cannot be emptied
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Click the date chip.
  4. Look for a way to clear the date.
  5. Close the date menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 4:

  • there is no way to leave the report without a date.

Step 5:

  • the chip still shows a date and the report still shows rows for it.

Why this matters: An aging report without an as-of date has no meaning.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:191-201. V1 code, quoted: `key: 'asOfDate', ... required: true,`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-012) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
